_meta.description: Curated reference index of the real public documents for the corpus. URLs were confirmed to resolve to the intended document on 2026-09-23 via web search; nothing here has been bulk-downloaded yet (run scripts/fetch_sources.py).
_meta.note_on_cited_clauses: cited_clauses_seen lists only clauses visible in the excerpts checked while building this index. It is NOT a complete list of what each letter cites; the extraction step (Version 1, point 2) will produce the full list.

sources.title: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Finished Pharmaceuticals
sources.publisher: US Government (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register / GPO)
sources.reuse_note: US federal regulation (public domain). eCFR is an unofficial, continuously updated edition; cite the official CFR for legal use.
sources.chunking_hint: one chunk per section (e.g. 211.22, 211.68, 211.100); keep paragraph letters (a)(b)(c) as sub-locators

sources.title: EudraLex Volume 4, Annex 11: Computerised Systems (revision 1, in operation 30 June 2011)
sources.reuse_note: European Commission publication; reuse generally permitted with attribution under the Commission's reuse policy. Confirm terms before redistributing full text in the public repo (the fetch script keeps raw text out of git by default).
sources.chunking_hint: one chunk per numbered clause 1-17 (e.g. 9 Audit Trails, 11 Periodic evaluation, 13 Incident Management); sub-clauses like 4.1-4.8 keep their numbers
sources.notes: A draft revision of Annex 11 was reported in progress as of Aug 2026; this index pins the version currently in force.
